renderings.value: Curious gazes, gazes carrying a bit of murderous intent...it goes without saying that I couldn't be more uncomfortable.
The old woman extended a loving hand to the children.
He sent me an affectionate letter.
He often shuts himself up in the study and writes things like this.
In the heavenly sea, waves of clouds rise; the moon appears as if it were a boat, hidden among the starry groves.
